# Frozen independent Progress material planes

Twelve source-derived CPU expected PNGs, frozen before root browser measurement. No production Progress implementation, screenshot, output, renderer helper or snapshot was read/imported by this author. Only the permitted public model fields/selector contract, original UI/metadata/material files and source identity ledger were used. These generated PNGs are test expectations, never runtime art.

The explicit finite Web host is width200, scale1, external opaque backdrop#203040. Spinner/autosave/thick parent height100, fancy parent height101. Every expected image is the COMPLETE200×100 or200×101 target plane: no ROI cropping, masks, tolerance or pixel exclusions. Selector and exact props/case dimensions are in PLANES.json; freeze invariants are in PROTOCOL.json. Pixel/PNG identities are pinned separately.

| Thick visible ratios0/.5/1 |200×100|[10,43,180,14]; empty below full; full visible width0/90/180|

Source declares explicit center anchors for fancy/thick/autosave. Spinner's omitted default anchors are resolved to center by this predeclared finite Web profile; no native default-anchor recovery is claimed. The model's `percentage` is0..1 and the root confirmed `imageClipPolicy="visible-fraction-web"`: leftmost fraction remains visible. Literal source `clip_direction:left` plus binding to `clip_ratio` alone does not establish this algorithm. The alternative left-removal-web policy is not measured here.

Fancy material isolation was approved BEFORE measurement: only `progress.progress_bar_nub` paint becomes `visibility:hidden`, retaining its complete[15,48,170,5] box, offsets, parent/bar and flow. Do not remove it, resize/crop a parent, hide either bar image, change its alpha or mask pixels. Root may adapt the DOM selector for that source-control leaf only and must record its actual selector plus unchanged geometry. This isolates the independent empty/full bar material; it does not certify the natural composite fancy indicator.

Original files remain byte-exact in ORIGINALS, including complete untransformed PNGs, their original JSON metadata, progress/achievement/global JSON and original license. ORIGINALS.json and the fixed source study ledger provide identity. No asset crops, synthetic replacements, source metadata changes or screen captures were used as material inputs.

## Independent arithmetic and qualifications

The CPU mapper pulls each destination pixel CENTRE through piecewise nine-slice intervals using integer floor/rational arithmetic. Border widths come directly from raw metadata: fancy full[1,0,1,0], empty[6,1,6,1], thick[1,1,1,1]. The point-sampling choice, parent/default fill resolution and interval mapping are explicit Web comparison assumptions, not native shader reconstruction. Integer destination origins remove CSS fractional-box rasterization ambiguity in this protocol.

All five qualified source PNGs have binary alpha0/255. The external plane alpha is255; transparent source texels leave it unchanged. There is no partial-alpha compositing in a qualified plane. Untinted source RGB passes through exactly. Thick source4×4 contains only opaque black/white; source global fill[.263,.627,.109] gives white[67.065,159.885,27.795], nearest integer[67,160,28]. Empty[.24,.24,.24] gives61.2, nearest61. No products are exactly halfway between integers. nearest-integer UNORM/color output is the predeclared CPU quantization assumption; browser/native proof is still needed. Generator asserts binary alpha, source bytes/metadata, dimensions, no exact-half tie and complete opaque output. It imports PNG serialization only, not product code.

Three source families remain unqualified instead of inventing certainty:

- Wave: opaque white255×source tint.7 is EXACT178.5. Without a recovered browser/native quantization path, choosing178 or179 as an unconditional zero-tolerance truth would be unjustified. Whole loading_bar original and metadata are retained, but no passing wave oracle is claimed.
- Independent nub: original11×5 contains25 opaque and30 partial-alpha texels, zero fully transparent texels. Source says tiled; exact tile origin/default behavior and PNG premultiplication/rounding order remain unresolved. Straight-alpha rational compositing over an opaque integer backdrop has denominator255 and no exact-half final tie, but that fact alone does not establish browser texture upload premultiplication. No nub pixel gate is certified. Its source material remains retained independently of the fancy bar isolation.
- Custom: renderer progress_bar_renderer has no recovered shader implementation or background texture declaration in its own source control. Do not invent a green fill or empty-background golden as native evidence. Cloud-upload templates, reverse timing, interpolation, frame transitions, other scales, native font/layout and natural combined root pages are also outside these12 cases.

Zero differences in a later measured case may support exactly that declared material/profile/state. It cannot certify all ProgressIndicators, native rendering, complete screen UI or any of the explicitly excluded families. Any failure must retain the measured complete actual plane and frozen expected identity; fix product/harness in a NEW recorded revision. Do not edit expected references after observing browser output.
